Represent compressed full-history groups with block-rounded capacity. Keep the padded physical pool count and one null reservation; expose any scalar rounding explicitly.

Prove native and Replay capacity separately. A conservative full-history bound for every non-circular group plus one page per circular group per resident request avoids assuming exact rolling behavior; include startup/full-sequence admission, watermark, reservation and PP1 asynchronous lookahead. A failed loose bound is inconclusive, not evidence that serving cannot fit.
